label: Rectified flow and where to train it

spec.title: SD3's training objective: a straight path, sampled in the middle
spec.caption: Esser et al. 2024, Eqs. 13, 19, 23. Data at t = 0, noise at t = 1.
spec.main_latex: \mathcal L = \mathbb E_{t \sim \pi(t),\, x_0,\, \varepsilon}\ \big\| v_\theta(z_t, t \mid c) - (\varepsilon - x_0) \big\|^2,\qquad z_t = (1 - t)\, x_0 + t\, \varepsilon

steps.explanation: Logit-normal sampling of t puts training effort in the middle of the path, where the velocity is hardest to predict. With m = 0, s = 1 it ranked first among 61 formulations (Table 1).
Resolution shift: more pixels need more noise to destroy the same signal. SD3 uses a shift of √(m/n) = 3 at 1024², for training and sampling.

steps.latex: x_0 = z_t - t\, v, \qquad \varepsilon = z_t + (1 - t)\, v
steps.explanation: The velocity model is a denoiser in disguise: the same quantity AF3's D_θ returns, reached by a different parameterisation.
